findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of pandas.eval (potential code injection)
 * @description Detect calls to pandas.eval which can evaluate arbitrary expressions when used with untrusted input.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pandas-eval-use
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from API::CallNode apiCall
where
  apiCall = API::moduleImport("pandas").getMember("eval").getACall()
select apiCall, "Call to pandas.eval, which can execute arbitrary code if given untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: pandas.eval may be used in ways that allow code injection when passed untrusted data.

message.text: Call to pandas.eval, which can execute arbitrary code if given untrusted input.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Pandas unsafe pickle helpers
 * @description Detect internal helpers that wrap pickle.load/loads and may deserialize untrusted data.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pandas-internal-pickle-use
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from API::CallNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Internal use of pickle load/loads; ensure callers do not pass untrusted data."
findings.hypothesis: Pandas uses pickle.load/loads internally for IO helpers, which is unsafe for untrusted data.

message.text: Internal use of pickle load/loads; ensure callers do not pass untrusted data.
